symptom: run --local --db-type postgresql|hsqldb works but is in neither the run-local skill's nor docs-site/src/tools/run-local.md's flag table; users without PostgreSQL hit 'no local PostgreSQL superuser available to create the role/database' instead of finding --db-type hsqldb
cause: Flag shipped with help text and proposals only. Separately, the skill's --app-port and --db-host/--db-name/--db-user/--db-password rows had drifted below the OpenTelemetry section, detached from the table header, so they rendered as stray text — a grep for '--db-name' in SKILL.md matched and hid that the table did not contain it
insight: Check flag-table coverage by parsing the table (rows under a '| Flag |' header), not by grepping the file: a stranded row or a prose mention passes a grep. The test reads the --db-* set from runCmd.Flags(), so the next database flag fails it without editing the test. Full-flag coverage was not asserted because several other run flags (--configuration, --constant, --hub-prefix…, --page-check) are also absent — a separate gap.
